panel.title: Lab partner
panel.intro: Ask about your wiring, your code or a fault. I give hints before answers, and if a friend in your room has done this lesson, I ask them first.

errors.not_configured: The lab partner isn’t set up on this deployment.
errors.rate_limited: Lots of questions right now. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
errors.bad_input: That couldn’t be sent. Try a shorter question.
errors.upstream: The partner didn’t answer this time. Try again.
errors.offline: You’re offline. The lab still works; the partner needs a connection.
errors.no_key: Add your AI key in settings to use the lab partner.

status.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the server to check the partner.

state.notSetUp: The partner isn’t set up yet. Choose a provider in settings.
state.needsKey: This provider needs a key. Add it in settings.
state.capped: Today’s spending limit is reached. Raise it in settings.
state.offline: You’re offline. The lab still works; the partner needs a connection.

debugging.name: Debugging
debugging.hint: Hunts for the cause of a fault, step by step.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.hint: Plain words, small steps, a question at the end.

partner.keyRemoved: A value that looked like a key was removed from your message.

error.not_configured: Set up an AI provider in settings.
error.auth: The provider did not accept this key.
error.bad_model: This model is not available to your key.
error.context_too_long: This project is too large for this model. Select a part or choose a larger model.

error.capped: Today’s limit is reached. Raise it in settings.

error.relay_denied: Your server did not allow this.
error.upstream_busy: The provider is busy. Try again.
error.upstream_timeout: The provider took too long. Try again.
error.filtered: The provider declined to answer this. Try rephrasing.
